Extend a planar, closed curve to a boundary with gap

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `FitCrv`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Planar, closed curve to extend |
| Plane | `Pl` | Plane | Item |  | Plane boundary |
| Gap | `G` | Number | Item | `0.00` | Gap from boundary |
| Edge | `E` | Line | Item | optional | Manual pick edge to extend |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item | Extened curve |
